content: {"like":["Values flawless, high‑quality performances and singers who bring both technical strength and stylistic integrity;","Prefers traditional, cohesive productions with strong directorial vision and clear, engaging staging;","Appreciates minimalist or well‑crafted scenic design that enhances the narrative without distraction;","Enjoys supplementary content such as making‑of featurettes, commentary tracks, and detailed booklets;","Seeks productions that maintain authenticity and avoid gimmicky or over‑produced elements."],"dislike":["Dislikes conductors or productions that feel arrogant or bumptious;","Rejects recordings or releases that lack technical polish or contain distracting production errors;","Avoids content that feels routine, dull, or poorly structured;","Dislikes omissions of meaningful moments or essential visual details in home video releases;","Prefers to avoid pretentious or confusing artistic choices that obscure the core performance."]}
